# Sources {.unnumbered}

Every specific claim in this book — every date, dollar figure, name, address,
and quotation — is traceable to a source recorded in the project research log.

Wikipedia appears nowhere in these sources. It was used to navigate toward
primary and scholarly material, which is what is cited.

Where historians genuinely disagree, the text says so, gives the strongest
version of each position, and identifies which reading this book finds more
persuasive and why. Those passages are marked in the research log as contested.
No chapter's argument rests on a contested fact.
